title: Can't steer left or right
backstory: A player complains that the spider can only move up and down. Rotating the trackball left or right does nothing.
visible_effect: Dragging the trackball pad left/right sends zero dx to MAME; only vertical movement works
diagnosis_hint: With the cabinet open, watch the X-axis opto-interrupter LED with the trackball rolling. Dead LED = dead opto. Replace the opto or clean the encoder disc slot.
